title: Payroll Tender Figures Printed against Each Employee Meal Account Plan
content:
Where a meal plan lets the diner eat now and have the charge carried to pay, the payroll office of Larkspur Table Workplace Dining Group reads seven figures off the plan the Employee Meal Account is held on.

| Meal plan | Payroll tender offered | Ceiling on charges awaiting recovery | Ceiling on what one payroll period recovers | Remittance lag after a period closes | Arrears at which payroll tender is switched off | Grace after the threshold is passed | Share of outstanding arrears required before restriction is lifted |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Pay-As-You-Go Badge Account | no | $0.00 | $0.00 | 0 calendar days | $0.00 | 0 calendar days | 0 percent |
| Prepaid Declining Balance Account | no | $0.00 | $0.00 | 0 calendar days | $0.00 | 0 calendar days | 0 percent |
| Payroll Deduction Meal Account | yes | $250.00 | $125.00 | 7 calendar days | $200.00 | 10 calendar days | 50 percent |
| Subsidized Daily Allowance Account | yes | $120.00 | $60.00 | 7 calendar days | $100.00 | 7 calendar days | 100 percent |
| Full Subsidy Employee Meal Account | no | $0.00 | $0.00 | 0 calendar days | $0.00 | 0 calendar days | 0 percent |
| Executive Dining Charge Account | yes | $1800.00 | $900.00 | 14 calendar days | $1500.00 | 21 calendar days | 25 percent |

## The seven figures

1. Payroll tender offered says whether meals may be tendered against payroll rather than stored value.
2. The arrears ceiling is the most charges awaiting payroll recovery may come to.
3. The deduction ceiling is the most one payroll period may recover.
4. The remittance lag is the calendar days between a pay period closing and its deduction being remitted.
5. The restriction threshold is the arrears figure at which payroll tender is switched off, and the grace figure is the calendar days of grace after that threshold is passed before restriction applies.
6. The reinstatement share is the share of outstanding arrears that must be paid before restriction is lifted, as a percentage.

## Where payroll tender is offered

Three of the six plans offer it: the Payroll Deduction Meal Account, the Subsidized Daily Allowance Account and the Executive Dining Charge Account. Against the other three every figure in this schedule prints as nothing — $0.00 arrears ceiling, $0.00 deduction ceiling, 0 calendar days of lag, $0.00 threshold, 0 calendar days of grace and 0 percent reinstatement share.

Of the three that do offer it, the Payroll Deduction Meal Account prints a $250.00 arrears ceiling, a $125.00 deduction ceiling, 7 calendar days of lag, a $200.00 threshold, 10 calendar days of grace and a 50 percent reinstatement share; the Subsidized Daily Allowance Account prints $120.00, $60.00, 7 calendar days, $100.00, 7 calendar days and 100 percent; and the Executive Dining Charge Account prints $1800.00, $900.00, 14 calendar days, $1500.00, 21 calendar days and 25 percent.
